info.title: mìmú API
info.description:
Self-service DOOH advertising platform for Lagos, Nigeria.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT token obtained via OTP or password login.
Programmatic (public API) endpoints use an org API key via the `X-API-Key` header.
Admin endpoints use session cookies issued after Google OAuth + TOTP verification.

## User Types
- **Advertiser** — brands running ad campaigns
- **Host** — venue owners with DOOH screens
- **Admin** — internal mìmú operations staff
